import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C_table = new long[777][777];
    static int R_val, C_val;
    static long total_combinations;
    static long min_difference = (long)1e18;
    static long best_solution = -1;
    static char[] input_buffer = new char[12345];
    static int[] prefix_count_A = new int[12345];
    static int[] prefix_count_B = new int[12345];
    static Map<Long, Long> memo_table = new HashMap<>();

    static void search(long A_val, long B_val, int i_idx, int j_idx) {
        long diff = Math.abs(A_val - B_val);
        if (min_difference <= 1 || diff - C_table[i_idx][R_val] * C_table[j_idx][R_val] >= min_difference)
            return;
            
        if (i_idx == R_val - 1 && j_idx == R_val - 1) {
            long cur_diff = Math.abs(A_val - B_val);
            if (cur_diff < min_difference) {
                min_difference = cur_diff;
                best_solution = A_val;
            }
            return;
        }
        
        if (i_idx >= R_val) {
            long delta_A = C_table[i_idx][R_val] - C_table[i_idx - 1][R_val];
            long sum_B = C_table[j_idx][R_val];
            search(A_val, B_val + delta_A * sum_B, i_idx - 1, j_idx);
        }
        
        if (j_idx >= R_val) {
            long sum_A = C_table[i_idx][R_val];
            long delta_B = C_table[j_idx][R_val] - C_table[j_idx - 1][R_val];
            search(A_val + sum_A * delta_B, B_val, i_idx, j_idx - 1);
        }
    }

    static long count_paths(long A_val, long B_val, int i_idx, int j_idx) {
        long state_key = A_val * 10000 + i_idx * 100 + j_idx;
        if (memo_table.containsKey(state_key))
            return memo_table.get(state_key);
            
        long[] optimal = new long[1];
        long diff = Math.abs(A_val - B_val);
        if (diff - C_table[i_idx][R_val] * C_table[j_idx][R_val] > min_difference) {
            optimal[0] = 0;
            memo_table.put(state_key, optimal[0]);
            return optimal[0];
        }
        
        if (i_idx < R_val || j_idx < R_val) {
            if (i_idx >= prefix_count_A[i_idx + j_idx] && j_idx >= prefix_count_B[i_idx + j_idx]) {
                int total = i_idx + j_idx;
                i_idx -= prefix_count_A[total];
                j_idx -= prefix_count_B[total];
                optimal[0] = C_table[total][i_idx];
                memo_table.put(state_key, optimal[0]);
                return optimal[0];
            }
            optimal[0] = 0;
            memo_table.put(state_key, optimal[0]);
            return optimal[0];
        }
        
        optimal[0] = 0;
        char current_char = input_buffer[i_idx + j_idx - 1];
        if (current_char != 'B') {
            long delta_A = C_table[i_idx][R_val] - C_table[i_idx - 1][R_val];
            long sum_B = C_table[j_idx][R_val];
            optimal[0] += count_paths(A_val, B_val + delta_A * sum_B, i_idx - 1, j_idx);
        }
        if (current_char != 'A') {
            long sum_A = C_table[i_idx][R_val];
            long delta_B = C_table[j_idx][R_val] - C_table[j_idx - 1][R_val];
            optimal[0] += count_paths(A_val + sum_A * delta_B, B_val, i_idx, j_idx - 1);
        }
        memo_table.put(state_key, optimal[0]);
        return optimal[0];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R_val = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        C_val = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R_val + C_val); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (R_val + C_val); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C_table[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C_table[i][j] = 0;
                else C_table[i][j] = C_table[i - 1][j] + C_table[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        
        total_combinations = C_table[R_val + C_val][R_val] * C_table[R_val + C_val][R_val];
        
        {
            long a = 0, b = 0;
            int i = R_val + C_val, j = R_val + C_val;
            while (i >= R_val && j >= R_val) {
                if (a > b) {
                    long delta_A = C_table[i][R_val] - C_table[i - 1][R_val];
                    long sum_B = C_table[j][R_val];
                    b += delta_A * sum_B;
                    i--;
                } else {
                    long sum_A = C_table[i][R_val];
                    long delta_B = C_table[j][R_val] - C_table[j - 1][R_val];
                    a += sum_A * delta_B;
                    j--;
                }
            }
            min_difference = Math.abs(a - b);
        }
        
        search(0, 0, R_val + C_val, R_val + C_val);
        String inputLine = br.readLine();
        input_buffer = inputLine.toCharArray();
        prefix_count_A[0] = prefix_count_B[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R_val + C_val); i++) {
            prefix_count_A[i + 1] = prefix_count_A[i] + (input_buffer[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            prefix_count_B[i + 1] = prefix_count_B[i] + (input_buffer[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        
        long final_result = count_paths(0, 0, R_val + C_val, R_val + C_val);
        System.out.println(final_result);
    }
}
